title: [new release] js_of_ocaml (8 packages) (6.5.0)
body: Compiler from OCaml bytecode to JavaScript - Project page: https://ocsigen.org/js_of_ocaml/latest/js_of_ocaml/overview.html - Documentation: https://ocsigen.org/js_of_ocaml/latest/js_of_ocaml/overview.html ##### CHANGES: ## Features/Changes ### OCaml versions * Compiler/Runtime: support for OCaml 5.6: use the optimization hints recorded in the bytecode, support the bit counting primitives and `Sys.filepath_exists`, `Weak.get_copy` no longer copies (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#1721, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2227, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2469, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2488, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2493, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2494) * Compiler/Runtime: OxCaml: block index and small-int string-like indexing primitives; OxCaml-specific primitives are gated on `//If: oxcaml` (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2342, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2463) * Compiler/Runtime: support building with Introcaml (OCaml fork with runtime introspection), gated by the `introspect` flag (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2409) * Compiler/Runtime: with Introcaml, support runtime introspection (`Introspect.Print` and friends) in JavaScript: the descriptor of a block is stored in its header word above the tag (`tag | (desc << 8)`), the block descriptors of the program are embedded, and `Marshal.Reserved_bits` is honored; can be disabled with `--disable introspection` (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2433) ### Compiler * Compiler: require sedlex 3.8.1 (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2503) * Compiler: faster compilation (about 25% faster than 6.4.1 on large programs): new `Int_trie` and `Int_set` data structures, sharing-preserving `Subst` and `Js_traverse.map`, `Js_traverse.free` as an iterator, circular-buffer worklists, faster JavaScript printer and lexer (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2445, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2446, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2447, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2448, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2449, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2452, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2454, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2512) * Compiler: keep the name of function expressions that do not refer to themselves; the `unused-js-vars` warning now reports such names (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2449) * Compiler: emit large binary string constants as base64 literals, which are much smaller than `\xNN`-escaped literals (-14% on the toplevel example) (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2432) * Compiler: report JavaScript syntax errors as `file:line:col` followed by the offending line; columns start from 1 (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2464, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2471, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2491) * Compiler: the JavaScript parser accepts source phase imports (`import source x from "m"`) (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2523) * Compiler: drop redundant `break`s out of labelled blocks, turning the blocks into `if`/`else` statements or conditional expressions; the nesting this introduces is bounded by `--set=break_sink_depth`, and the `merge_node_max` parameter is renamed `label_depth` (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2513) * Compiler: simplify the generated JavaScript (`!x` for negated conditions, no empty `if` branches) (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2500) * Compiler: omit the `| 0` coercion after an unsigned right shift by a constant (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2531) * Compiler: inline pending expressions at the end of a `try` body, avoiding temporaries such as `try{var c = f(x); return c;}` (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2532) * Compiler: bind identical literals of a bytecode program to a single variable, which shrinks the generated code and speeds up compilation of programs with many duplicated constants; identical literals may now be physically equal (`==`) (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2547) * Compiler: fold `if (c) return a; return b` into `return c ? a : b` (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2533) * Compiler: test integers against 0 by truthiness (`!x` rather than `0 === x`) when the result is only used as a condition (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2538) * Compiler: simplify `!c ? a : b` into `c ? b : a` (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2538) * Compiler: compare integers directly rather than comparing the result of `compare` with 0 (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2529) * Compiler: faster reading of debug events, used with `--pretty` and `--debug-info` (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2541, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2548) ### Effects * Compiler: with `--effects={cps,double-translation}`, specialize calls to known functions before the CPS transformation (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2458) * Compiler: with `--effects=double-translation`, only generate a CPS version of the functions that may run below an effect handler (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2441) * Compiler/Wasm: with `--effects=cps`, no longer turn mutually recursive functions into CPS, since Wasm has proper tail calls (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2441) * Runtime: specialize one- and two-argument partial applications in double-translation mode (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2437) ### Wasm * Compiler/Wasm: intern string constants (program-wide with whole-program compilation, per compilation unit otherwise) (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2436) * Compiler/Wasm: small code generation improvements (negation, physical equality on JavaScript values, bigarray dimensions, result types of runtime primitives, masking of i31 values, range checks in the runtime) (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2472, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2475, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2529) * Compiler/Wasm: add `--setenv`, matching js_of_ocaml (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2415) * Compiler/Wasm: emit a sourcemap mapping at the start of each function, for the Chrome profiler (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2417) * Compiler/Wasm: the linker supports the wide arithmetic and custom descriptor instructions (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2515) * Compiler/Wasm: store more long-lived toplevel variables in globals; fix a crash when one of them is assigned in a `try` body (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2516) * Runtime/Wasm: faster `caml_hash`, `compare`, lexer engines, `Str` searches and `output_value` sharing detection (with WASI, `output_value` now shares boxed numbers with equal contents); single bound check in fixed-width `Bytes` accesses (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2470, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2505) ### Libraries * Lib: add `WebGL2` bindings; the `webgl` example uses WebGL2 and a new `webgl2_particles` example demonstrates transform feedback (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#1226, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2388) * Lib: add `Crypto` (Web Crypto API) bindings (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2380) * Lib: add `Notification` and `Clipboard` bindings (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2379) * Lib: add Service Worker, `MessageChannel`/`MessagePort` and Cache API bindings (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2381) * Lib: add `FontFace` (CSS Font Loading API) bindings (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2255) * Lib: add the Pointer Capture API to `Dom_html.element`, and `getPredictedEvents`, `altitudeAngle` and `azimuthAngle` to `pointerEvent` (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2403) * Lib: consolidate the duplicate `messageEvent` class types into `('target, 'data) Dom_html.messageEvent`; the old ones are deprecated class type aliases (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2382, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2390, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2555) * Lib: add `Lwt_js_events.mutation`/`mutations` (`MutationObserver`) (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#250) * Lib: `Lwt_js_events.load`/`error`/`abort` accept any element, not only images (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2404) * Lib (breaking): `Typed_array.float32Array_fromArray` and `float64Array_fromArray` take a `number_t js_array t`, as required by wasm_of_ocaml (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2416) * Lib (breaking): remove `js_of_ocaml-lwt.logger`, as `lwt_log` is deprecated (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2378) * Lib: the native stubs of the JavaScript primitives are weak symbols, so that they can be overridden (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2435) * Lib: add the `js_of_ocaml.devtools` library, whose `Js_of_ocaml_devtools.register_formatters` installs a custom formatter in `globalThis.devtoolsFormatters`: when the compiler is built with Introcaml, Chrome DevTools then displays OCaml values in OCaml syntax (`Circle ({x = 0; name = "o"}, 1)`), expandable to their fields by name; JavaScript values embedded in them are left to the console (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2433) ### Toplevel * Toplevel: new `Wrapped` and `Async` APIs, and `protocol`, `worker` and `worker_lwt_client` sublibraries to run the toplevel in a WebWorker (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#66, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#833, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2377) ## Bug fixes ### Compiler * Compiler: fix two reference unboxing bugs (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2426, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2489) * Compiler: fix an invariant violation with recursive inlining (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2482, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2495) * Compiler: fix variable coalescing with ES classes (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2462) * Compiler: fix unsound corner cases of the JavaScript simplification passes: `||` fusion of effectful conditions, dropped `var` declarations when folding an `if`, catch-parameter destructuring defaults (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2393) * Compiler: fix the printing of JavaScript code: parentheses around optional chains, no ES2021 logical assignments, keep the braces around a single block-scoped declaration (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2465, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2502) * Compiler: keep `static` on the same line as the class element it modifies (Safari 17 misparsed static class fields) (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2420, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2421) * Compiler: fix the JavaScript lexer on out-of-range unicode escapes, on CR, U+2028 and U+2029 inside strings and templates, on numeric separators in the integer part of a float, and on an HTML close comment `-->` after a multi-line comment (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2503, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2524) ### Effects * Compiler: with `--effects=cps` or `double-translation`, fix mutable local variables in `try` bodies and exception handlers (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2484) * Compiler: with `--effects=double-translation`, fix over-applications of functions that do not perform effects (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2455) * Compiler/Wasm: with `--effects=cps`, fix an assertion failure on a `try` whose body modifies a local reference, when compiled without `-g` (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2519) * Wasm: unhandled effects raise `Effect.Unhandled` (`--effects=native`) or `Failure` (`--effects=disabled`) instead of failing with a runtime error; handlers installed inside `assume_no_perform` work; `--effects=cps` no longer runs on a JSPI stack (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2434, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2441) ### Wasm * Compiler/Wasm: `x land y` was wrongly assumed to fit in 31 bits when only a negative operand did (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2490) * Compiler/Wasm: fix specialized `Bigarray.Genarray.get`/`set` accesses, and check the number of indices (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2427, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2505) * Compiler/Wasm: fix several bugs of the Wasm linker (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2504) * Compiler/Wasm: fix sourcemaps and toplevels on Windows (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2397, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2418) * Wasm: embed cmis when building a toplevel with separate compilation (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2227) * Wasm: the runtime (zstd, blake2, wasi libc) uses a single linear memory, as Safari does not support modules with several memories (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2405) * Wasm: resolve `.wasm` assets relative to the runtime file, so that `require`d programs work (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2389) ### Runtime * Runtime: on Windows, the console device names (`CON`, `CONIN$`, `CONOUT$`) can be opened from node; they were resolved against the current directory (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2525) * Runtime: `output_value` marshals forced lazy values as their value, and `caml_hash` (Wasm) follows forwarded values, as native code (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2486) * Runtime: the functions creating arrays of arbitrary length check `Sys.max_array_length` (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2499) * Runtime: fix `Str.string_partial_match` (OSEC-2026-21) (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2492) * Runtime: `caml_alloc_dummy_mixed` takes two arguments (OxCaml) (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2461) * Runtime: fix two nat bugs with 32-bit digits (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2460) * Runtime: fix comparison between an immediate and a custom block (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2391) * Runtime: preserve leading BOMs when converting strings to JavaScript (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2414) * Runtime: fix the toplevel relocation of unit names with `use-js-string` disabled (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2429) ### Libraries * Toplevel: keep `/static/cmis` on the load path across `Toploop.initialize_toplevel_env` (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#833, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2377) * Tyxml: keep the first of repeated attributes, as browsers do (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#968, ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2383) * Lib: `Form.form_elements` and `Form.get_form_contents` skip ``, as a native form submission does; a named one was sent as a field with its value (ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2466)
